title: GitHub's 403 means two things.
description: Agent Idea asks GitHub whether you are in a team. GitHub answers 403 for 'no' and for 'slow down'. How we tell them apart, and what we did about token expiry.
lede: A 403 from GitHub can mean “you may not” or “not now”. Our access check has to treat those differently, in opposite directions.
summary: How Agent Idea's team gate reads GitHub's 403: a denial when the token is not allowed, an error when it is a rate limit. Plus the token expiry warning and its rounding bug.
